moves.text: Saturn moves from Meena into Mesha.
moves.until_text: Saturn stays in Mesha until 20 October 2027, when it moves into Meena.

moves.text: Saturn leaves your 12th house and enters your 1st house.
moves.from_theme: The 12th house is about rest, spending and faraway places.
moves.to_theme: The 1st house is about yourself and how you begin things.

others.text: Jupiter stays in Kataka, your 4th house.
Rahu stays in Makara, your 10th house.
Ketu stays in Kataka, your 4th house.

moves.text: Saturn leaves your 10th house and enters your 11th house.
moves.from_theme: The 10th house is about career and standing.
moves.to_theme: The 11th house is about gains and friends.

others.text: Jupiter stays in Kataka, your 2nd house.
Rahu stays in Makara, your 8th house.
Ketu stays in Kataka, your 2nd house.
